title: ipomoea serpyllifolia
intro: Ipomoea serpyllifolia, commonly known as the Creeping Morning Glory, is a perennial plant species native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain relief due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea serpyllifolia include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, which have been used to treat anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
